text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, after Sakura Chiyono O has a
number of
victories under her belt...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Chiyono O and I are riding a train
to the
hot spring vacation we won at the
shopping
district's raffle.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
We'll have to transfer trains in seven
stations.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Let me know if you want to take a
nap. I'll
stay awake for us.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Nooo can do.
choice_data_list: Let me know if you get sleepy too.
Let me know if you get sleepy too, okay?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Today, it's my turn to take care of
you.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I even prepared a schedule for us, after
all.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The day before we set off, she gave me a small pamphlet titled Hot Spring Vacation Schedule.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Emblazoned in huge letters on the first
page is "A
Giant Thank-You Gift for My
Amazing Trainer!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Wow, this place looks so luxurious! It
must be
pretty renowned.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
And now, please open to page five of
your
schedule.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Yes! That's right! I did some research in
advance...
choice_data_list: 'Apparently a certain famous Umamusume uses it too.'

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
But it seems neither of our rooms have
karaoke
machines in them...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I mean, it would've been fun to get
rowdy and
belt out a few songs after
relaxing in the hot
spring!
choice_data_list: *That's* what you're disappointed about?
So *that's* what you're disappointed about.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
But since we can't do that, I practiced
some magic
tricks instead! Hehe. I'll
show you them in our free
time!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I did! Now then, why don't you head into
the hot
springs first?
choice_data_list: Fully prepared!
Fully prepared!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With Sakura Chiyono O pushing me
forward, we
head into the building. I can
already tell she's
going to be a good
host during this trip.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure accepting her hospitality will be
the thing
that'll make her happiest, so I
decide to do just
that.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Please do!
choice_data_list: I'll be heading out first, then.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so I head for the hot spring...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Soaking in the hot spring...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After finishing my bath, I wait for Sakura
Chiyono
O and read the magazine she
gave me
beforehand in case I got out
before her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She seems to have considered every
possibility
for today. However, I came
here for a different
reason.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This hot spring vacation is also a reward
for all of
her hard work.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer! You're already out!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: ...Hm? What's that in your hand?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Really? Th-thank you for thinking of me.
choice_data_list: Here's your fruit milk.
Here's your fruit milk.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
But wait! You didn't have to do that.
Today's my
day to take care of you!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Wh-what?! N-no, that's okay...
choice_data_list: To me, today's a day I want to pamper you.
To me, today is a day to show you some appreciation.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
You're the one who's always looking
after me,
and it's not like I've really
done anything that
deserves to be
rewarded...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: O-oh... Heh. Yeah... Well...
choice_data_list: You've won so many races.
You've won so many races.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Those victories were all thanks to you,
so... If
anything, I should be the one
who's grateful.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! I told you that was thanks to
you.
choice_data_list: You showed me how hard you can try.
You've shown me how hard you can try.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
After all, you were the one who taught
me how to
work so hard.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...Ehehe. Anyway, what's gotten into
you? You're
making me blush!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Wha...
choice_data_list: As your Trainer, I'm so proud of you.
As your Trainer, I'm so proud of you.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
choice_data_list: Thanks, Chiyono O.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ehe... Ehehe...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Thank you too, Trainer. For everything.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh, gosh! I don't know what to do
with myself...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Please don't look at me anymore... It's
making me
feel embarrassed...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Siiigh... I wasn't expecting to get praised today... It's completely thrown me off...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I messed up the magic tricks I prepared,
and now
we're just lazing around. I
hardly even realized
when I finished
eating my dinner...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Urgh...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, you're way too nonchalant
about this!
choice_data_list: As long as you were able to relax, that's what counts.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Nooo! Don't look at me yet. You're
going to
make me remember our
conversation from earlier!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Argh... Sigh... Anyway, um... Like I said, thank you for everything!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After saying that, she covers her face
with her
hands and rolls around on the
tatami mats in
embarrassment.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I sense that Sakura Chiyono O and I
have formed
an irreplaceable bond
during this time together.
